description: Search the Confluence of a project's own Jira site (see get_linked_confluence_page) with CQL, as its own search does — e.g. 'type = page AND text ~ "onboarding" ORDER BY lastmodified DESC', 'space = ENG AND title ~ "release"', 'parent = 123456'. Answers each page's confluence_page_id, confluence_url, title, space, an excerpt and when it changed; read one whole with get_linked_confluence_page. A query the site cannot read comes back with its reason. This tracker's own wiki is searched with search_wiki. Name the project by 'project', or an issue here by 'issue'. For the people who work in the project; at most 10 reads of the linked site a minute per person.

cql.description: The CQL query, as that Confluence reads it.

issue.description: An issue here, e.g. 'PM-12', whose project's site is searched.

limit.description: How many pages, at most 30. Default 10.

project.description: Project key here, e.g. 'PM'. Or give 'issue'.

name: search_linked_confluence
